envMap.description: Environment as a map. Literal values only; a name that looks like a secret must be an object with valueFrom (secretKeyRef). RabbitMQ settings are not supported: the event bus is NATS.

(PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN|SALT|_KEY|REDIS_U.description: A secret value must come from a Secret (valueFrom.secretKeyRef), never from the values.

configMap.description: Non-secret settings (rendered into a ConfigMap). Secret-looking names are refused.

envFrom.description: Whole Secrets or ConfigMaps to expose as environment: {<name>: Secret|ConfigMap}.

resources.description: CPU and memory requests and a memory limit are mandatory.

allowInsecureIssuer.description: Never true outside the local mock OIDC server.

nats.description: NATS credentials of this component. Empty values fall back to the shared nats.existingSecret / nats.credsKey.

prefixes.description: Path prefixes the proxy uses. The operational and anonymous routes (/public, /discord, /prometheus, /swagger, /health, /admin, /auth) can never be added.

replicaCount.description: Exactly one bot: two would post everything twice.

auditWebhookKey.description: Key of existingSecret that holds the staff audit webhook URL. A secret: never a value in the values.

nats.description: NATS credentials of this component. Empty values fall back to the shared nats.existingSecret / nats.credsKey.

then.description: NATS credentials missing: set nats.existingSecret or backend.nats.existingSecret.
NATS credentials missing: set nats.existingSecret or discord.nats.existingSecret.

clamav.description: The evidence virus scan is enabled but no scanner is configured: set clamav.enabled=true or clamav.externalHost.

enabled.description: web: use either ingress or httpRoute, never both.
portal: use either ingress or httpRoute, never both.
